name: Microsoft Store
tagline: 微软应用商店，正版软件一键装
taglineEn: Microsoft's app store with one-click genuine apps
description: 直达微软官方的应用商店（Microsoft Store）。商店里的软件都经过微软审核、由商店统一更新，装完不用自己盯版本；不少常用的免费软件在商店里都有正版版本，适合教室里图省事的装机方式。
descriptionEn: A direct link to Microsoft Store. Apps in the Store are reviewed by Microsoft and updated centrally, so you do not have to track versions yourself. Many popular free apps have genuine Store versions, which makes classroom deployment simpler.
notice: 本机若没有「应用商店」，上面的商店链接会打不开，或反过来让你「先去商店里下载商店」——变成死循环。联网状态下按 Win+R 输入 wsreset -i 回车，Windows 会自动把商店装回来（1–3 分钟，期间没有进度条）；若仍无效，用管理员身份打开 PowerShell 执行 winget install 9WZDNCRFJBMP。装好后回到本页点「下载」即可。
noticeEn: If this PC has no Store app, the Store link above may fail or ask you to download the Store from the Store — a dead loop. While online, press Win+R and run wsreset -i; Windows will reinstall the Store automatically (1–3 minutes with no progress bar). If that fails, open PowerShell as administrator and run winget install 9WZDNCRFJBMP. Then return to this page and click Download.
author: Microsoft
